note: One beat per take (voiceover-human.md section 5.5). Tags follow the house style: billed, not spoken. Clean alt swaps the one cuss for Facebook reach.

beats.text: [casual, a little grin] Okay, real quick question.
[curious, leaning in] You got a drawer full of old silverware... that nobody even uses?
[low, real, half-sigh] 'Cause man... rent's due Friday. Light bill's due...
[frustrated, knowing] and that damn drawer's just sittin' there.
beats.clean: [frustrated, knowing] and that drawer's just sittin' there.

beats.text: [quieter, slower] Look real close... there's a tiny little stamp.
[lighting up] Nine-twenty-five. Or it straight up says... sterling.
[firm, plain] That ain't plated. That's real silver.
[slow, letting it land] So... rent's due.
[warmer, slower] And you got real silver... just sittin' in a drawer.
[half-laugh, knowing] Yeah. Now you see it.
[warm, steady] A-G Refining. Houston's silver buyer.
